_comment: TOOLIFY tool-to-node pairing registry (reverted out of CONTRACT.md §5.1, CONTRACT-PAIRINGS-1). Each entry records a browser tool that intentionally keeps its page (UI) alongside a ChainGraph node (proof) for the same computation. Checked by scripts/check-tool-node-pairings.mjs, wired into preflight.

pairings.rationale: Same AIRB/FIRB/SA RAROC calculation as a provable ChainGraph node with a §4 execution_hash artifact.
DSCR/interest-coverage calculation gained a provable ChainGraph counterpart alongside its browser tool.
Three related liquidity/leverage calculators consolidate into one provable ChainGraph node.
GloBE ETR/jurisdiction and top-up tax/QDMTT calculators pair to one provable ChainGraph node.
Embedded insurance pricing modeller gained a provable ChainGraph counterpart alongside its browser tool.
Cross-border B2B fee calculator gained a provable ChainGraph counterpart alongside its browser tool.
FX netting simulator gained a provable ChainGraph counterpart alongside its browser tool.

Special case: pairs with the pre-existing art-254 node — no new kernel was built, since art-254 already computes that ratio. This is the entry a future audit would otherwise misread as a missing kernel.
